top.line: A brief for a factory that deploys SG/Send and sgit servers from a request file, in any account and region.

in-short.line: A server factory, request in and server out, four shapes, one bootstrap stack, GitHub for the factory, phases.

why.line: Vaults need servers in the owner's account and region; the image, templates and OIDC pattern exist.

name.line: The SGit Server Factory, with its agent factory.server; sgit-deploy stays the Action.

request.line: A server.json per request: account, region, shape, storage, time to live, owner; the token sealed, never stored.

shapes.line: Ephemeral Lambda in memory, Lambda on S3, an EC2 appliance, Fargate: one image, one smoke test.

pipeline.line: Validate, check, copy the image, deploy, prove with a vault push and clone, record, tear down.

accounts.line: One bootstrap stack per account, a StackSet or a Terraform module, then one line in accounts.json.

regions.line: Everything derives from account and region; the image copied on first use; one us-east-1 caveat.

github.line: The factory is a repository and trusted through OIDC; servers need no repository of their own.

phases.line: Our account first, then ephemeral, regions, a second account, customers, the Action and skill.

prompt.line: The brief for factory.server: goal, what to read, the rules, and phase 1 to start.

limits.line: A brief, not built; beta templates; formats to settle.

sources.line: My brief and the SG/Send deploy templates, read on 21 November.
